item.text:
ResStock includes **high-rise apartment buildings**, but excludes **dormitories and assisted care facilities**.

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a *housing unit*. This excludes congregate housing but includes high-rise multifamily buildings—even when building codes classify them as commercial. See the [ResStock Technical Reference, Section 5](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf).

For high-rise apartments, ResStock models energy serving the dwelling units, including allocated shared heating and hot water. Most common-area energy, such as elevators, hallway lighting, and shared laundry, is excluded. See the [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html).
